text:
Lana CS: Quick sync — wants to run a 90m post-onboard enablement for Nova Health next week. Goal: hand off the runbook, capture early feedback, and surface any renewal risks. Who can help run the session and what time works?
Mike Enablement: I can lead the walkthrough. prefer mornings PST.
Adarsh CSM: I can join to cover account health & renewal flags. Can we include a 15m renewal pulse at the end?
Jules: +1 for the pulse. Also would like a short live Q&A on webhooks and keys.
Priya: Do we want a pre-read? I can send a 5–7 slide deck and a short prework survey to collect integration questions.
Lana CS: Yes please send pre-read. Proposed slots: Tue 10am PT, Wed 8am PT, Thu 1pm PT. Which one gets the most coverage for their EMEA + US engineers?
Mike Enablement: Tue 10am PT hits late afternoon EMEA, ok for most. :thumbsup:
Adarsh CSM: Tue works. I'll prep the renewal pulse talk and a checklist of risk signals.
Jules: Can you add a tiny agenda item to demo the CLI deploy flow? 7–8 minutes.
Priya: I'll draft the prework survey and include one question on data residency concerns. link to draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-prework (will publish tomorrow)
Lana CS: Agenda draft (short):
```
- 0–10m Introductions & goals
- 10–35m Product walkthrough (API, rate limits, model pinning)
- 35–50m Integration patterns + live webhook demo
- 50–65m CLI deploy walkthrough (Jules)
- 65–80m Renewal pulse + account health checklist (Adarsh)
- 80–90m Q&A and immediate action items
```
Mike Enablement: Looks good. Recommend we capture 2–3 success metrics they want to hit in the next 30 days and add to the runbook.
Priya: I'll attach the pre-read and prework link in the calendar invite once we confirm slot.
Lana CS: Cool — let's lock Tue 10am PT. @Mike Enablement please create the invite and add the deck + survey. @Ops Bot can you create a short meeting note doc and a follow-up task list?
Ops Bot: Calendar event created: Nova Health - Post-onboard Enablement — Tue 10:00 PDT. Invite link: https://calendar.internal/event/abc123. Meeting doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-enable-notes.
Mike Enablement: Invite sent. Added agenda and pre-read. Please RSVP and add integration questions to the survey before Friday.
Adarsh CSM: I'll share the account health checklist in the meeting doc by EOD Monday.
Jules: I'll prep the CLI snippet. Pasting here for quick review:
```bash
# deploy example
redwood deploy --model rwd-2B --quantize auto --route default
```
Priya: Draft survey link: https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-prework-survey. Two asks: 1) primary integration language, 2) any compliance constraints.
Lana CS: Great — thanks team. We'll run a 10m dry-run Monday 9am PT to make sure demos are smooth. Add to calendar if you can.
Mike Enablement: Added dry-run. See you all. :raised_hands:
